name: stackblitz-debug-bundle
description: Produce a privacy-safe WebContainer diagnostic bundle with browser capability, isolation-header, lifecycle, event, process-exit, dependency, and resource evidence. Use when an incident needs a shareable artifact rather than ad hoc console screenshots. Trigger with "StackBlitz debug bundle", "collect WebContainer diagnostics", or "WebContainer incident evidence".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to locate existing logging, header, boot, event, and process instrumentation. Use `WebFetch` only for current official StackBlitz
